programme.title: My Super Ex
programme.desc: Hillitön hittikomedia todistaa että eroaminen ei aina ole helppoa – joskus jopa hengenvaarallista! Matt Saunders (Luke Wilson) luulee löytäneensä ihannenaisensa kun hän tapaa Jenny Johnsonin (Uma Thurman), joka on fiksu, seksikäs... ja supersankari. Kun Matt kuitenkin haluaa erota, Jenny käynnistää supervoimaisen suloisen kostonsa.

programme.title: Love and Other Disasters
programme.desc: He ovat kolmekymppisiä, menestyviä, asuvat Lontoossa, eivätkä ole erityisen kiinnostuneita kiinteästä parisuhteesta. Siitä huolimatta Jacks järjestää ystävilleen sinnikkäästi sokkotreffejä. Ja nyt hän on löytänyt kämppäkaverilleen Peterille unelmien miehen, tumman latino-valokuvaaja Paolon. Mutta innostuksensa lomassa Jacks on jättänyt huomiotta pari pientä yksityiskohtaa Paolo ei ole homo ja hän on hulluna Jacksiin!

programme.title: The Boy Downstairs
programme.desc: Kun Diana palaa kotiin New Yorkiin vietettyään pari vuotta Lontoossa, hän löytää nopeasti täydellisen asunnon. Täydellisen... kunnes osoittautuu, että hänen entinen poikaystävänsä Ben asuu samassa talossa. Diana ja Ben törmäävät väistämättä toisiinsa, hyvinä ja huonoina hetkinä.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Farmer and Boatbuilder Enda and his wife Mags live on a 55 acre Brussel Sprout farm at Balheary near Swords in North Dublin. After three decades of life in the country, they're moving back to Enda's home town - the picturesque seaside village of Rush. Their new home, formerly owned by Enda's aunt is an old fisherman's house near the harbour.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Moate in County Westmeath, is a place where football is part sport, part religion. On an overgrown plot on the outskirts of town lies the abandoned future home of county GAA All Star Dessie Dolan, his wife Kelly and their 3-year-old son Nathan. They have bought themselves a dilapidated cottage on a hopelessly exposed site in the village.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At Sutton in North Dublin, Dermot extends a 1960s suburban house, changing a beloved childhood home into a sumptuous new one for Hannah, James and their twin sons. To give the couple the 'wow factor' they've asked for, Dermot designs a large L-shaped extension at the rear of the house with a soaring mezzanine level.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Having rented a house in Navan for the last two years, teacher Celine and sound engineer Dave are excited at the prospect of moving to a farmhouse once owned by her grandparents at Kildalkey village in County Meath where Celine grew up. The couple will be the fourth generation to live there and retaining the charm and character of the old place is a major concern for the whole family.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the three years since newlyweds Rosie and Keith bought their five-bed house in Templeogue, Dublin 6, they haven't changed a thing. From the dark, cold interiors to the cavity block, flat roofed extension, this house is a relic of 1970s design, with décor to match. Keen to create a unique take on the rather unimaginative suburban semi, Dermot designs a radical, steep-roofed extension...

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Country and Irish legend Daniel O'Donnell and his wife Majella share a large four bed detached home in Kincasslagh West Donegal. Unlike Daniel, who's fairly happy with the place, Majella is keen to upgrade and reconfigure the interior. With her husband on tour, she's determined to get the very best from her architect.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Nine years ago, Susie and Dave bought their dream home on the outskirts of Fermoy in Cork - a 170 year old three storey mansion that Susie has admired since she was a teenager. The house however, has begun to show its age and Susie and Dave want to extend and upgrade to create the ultimate family home.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: IT manager Christine has bought herself a red brick terraced house in Clontarf, North Dublin. Christine has big plans for the place but as Dermot quickly discovers, they're far bigger than her 130K budget will allow. And despite his best efforts, Dermot is unable to convince Christine to modify her 25 page wish list.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At the seaside village of Portrane in North Dublin, Dermot creates a workable home for three generations of the one family under the watchful, budget-conscious eyes of two sisters.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Recently returned to Ireland after 12 years in London, new parents website designer Cliona and IT manager Micheal have already spent 30 grand renovating a 1950s semi-D at Killester in North Dublin in their own distinctive, industrial style.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dairy farmer Padraig and schoolteacher Katie are hoping to create their 'forever' home by renovating a century-old farmhouse on a half acre of land recently inherited from Padraig's uncle. But delivering this dream won't be easy for their architect. Dermot's problems begin when he presents his initial design and it Katie announces that she has no time for 'open plan' living.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: At a 1960s 'Semi D' in Stillorgan, Dermot's vision of a million euro 'Malibu style' house for Rory and Lorna from the west of Ireland descends into an ongoing battle over the style and position of the front door.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: David and Nessa Conlon have just bought this 1990s split level detached bungalow and plan to move in with their three children (twin boys aged 11 and a 7 year old girl) once the renovations have been completed.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the second episode of Room To Improve, Dermot Bannon heads to Borrisoleigh, Co. Tipperary, to meet Joe Kenny and his bride to be Mary Hayes. Joe's house is a 3 bedroom, 2 storey house on a half acre site about half a mile from Borrisoleigh, with beautiful views of green fields. Mary and Joe are creating their dream home, to move into just after their wedding. Joe has lived the bachelor life up until now and his house reflects this. Dermot can see exactly why Mary is insisting on a redesign.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In the third episode of Room To Improve, Dermot Bannon heads to Rathfarnham, where Yvonne and Adrian Saunders live with their daughter Lauren. Yvonne and Adrian's house is a detached 1950s two-bedroom property, in need of massive transformation. Dermot likens it to a 'Hansel and Gretel' house.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: In Ashford Co. Wicklow stands the house of Nigel and Frances Coffey. Frances's parents live next door. Several years ago her father built a private road and gave seven plots of land to his seven children.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Claudia and Tom bought this 1920s bungalow with panoramic views of Tramore Bay in 2012 for 305K. Just back from living abroad (Spain, Dubai and Germany) they have been living in the house for the past year.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Glenn Keating and Gustav van der Westhuizen live in Grace Park, Drumcondra, with their 5-year-old son Noah and two pet Weimaraner dogs. They live in an Edwardian terraced three story house. The terrace was originally built for officers of the British Army, between 1897 and 1902. Glenn is a youth worker for LGBTI+ young people in the city centre and Gustav is a banker.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dermot had a journey to go on with this build with Lisa and Marc.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Laura's expectations from Dermot were high but to get the build to the construction stage was tricky due to the tight budget.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Paul and Hilary really want to modernise the house that was built originally in the 1970s but they have to be clever with their budget.

programme.title: Room to Improve
programme.desc: Dermot has a challenge, as he has to work within a tight budget of 210k and has a lot to do for what Jim and Mary want.

programme.title: Room to Improve

programme.desc: Cathy and Michael Keane bought their house when it was being used as a cowshed. They converted it, had four children and over the years Dad, Michael, has added on bits to it.

programme.desc: Declan and Judy Cadwell from Clontarf share a small terraced home with their three sons, Christopher 19, Ross 17 and Jake 13. But only just.

programme.desc: Dermot encounters a stumbling block or two when he turns his hand to a badly laid out bungalow in Co Offaly.

programme.desc: A young couple with three children seek Dermot's help in revamping their small three bedroomed bungalow in Ballinteer Ailish and Patrick Bates are a young couple running out of space - fast!

programme.desc: Room to Improve starts with Margaret and Jodie Burke who plan to renovate the family home in Foxrock.

programme.title: Room to Improve

programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E12 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 12, Romania Part 2
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E13 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 13, Curacao
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E14 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 14, Portugal
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E15 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 15, Dubai World grand finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S03 : E16 SCL 2016 Season 3, Episode 16, Dubai World grand finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E01 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 1, Norway
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E02 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 2, Germany
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E03 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 3, Lithuania
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E04 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 4, Holland
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E05 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 5, Serbia
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E06 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 6, Canada (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E07 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 7, Canada (Part 2)
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E08 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E09 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E10 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 10, Finland Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E11 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 11, Romania
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E12 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 12, Curacao
programme.desc: From now on every stage of these series will be more than crucial. Curacao is a beautiful Dutch island in the Caribbean, with a great atmosphere to hold another stage of the MLO Strongman Champions League. Let’s see who takes the title here and who will secure a place in the next stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 13, Jordan
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E14 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 14, Greece
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E15 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 15, Mexico World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S04 : E16 SCL 2017 Season 4, Episode 16, Mexico World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E04 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E05 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E06 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 6, Finland
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E07 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E08 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 8, Finland - U105 (Part 1)
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E09 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 9, Finland - U105 (Part 2)
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E10 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 10, Romania (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E11 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 11, Romania (Part 2)
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E12 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 12, Curacao (Part 1)
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.sub-title: S05 : E13 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 13, Curacao (Part 2)
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E14 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 14, Road to Mexico
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E15 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 15, Mexico - World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S05 : E16 SCL 2018 Season 5, Episode 16, Mexico - World Finals (Part 2)
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.sub-title: S06 : E02 SCL S6 Ep2 FIBO Power

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E03 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 3, Turkey
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E04 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 4, Holland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E05 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 5, Holland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 6, Russia
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E07 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 7, Serbia
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E08 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 8, Finland (Part 1)
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E09 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 9, Finland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E10 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 10, Portugal
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E11 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 11, Callio
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E12 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 12, Ukraine

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E13 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 13, Caribbean

Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E14 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 14, Dubai
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E15 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 15, World Finals (Part 1)
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S06 : E16 SCL 2019 Season 6, Episode 16, World Finals (Part 2)

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E02 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 2, Finland (Part 1)

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E03 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 3, Finland (Part 2)

programme.sub-title: S07 : E04 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 4, World Record Breakers
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: S07 : E05 SCL 2021 Season 7, Episode 5, Strongest Viking
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: iMPACT!
programme.desc: This week on TNA Thursday Night iMPACT! on AMC, The Hardys and The Righteous meet at The Hardy Compound, while TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth puts his title on the line against KC Navarro.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: Danny Trejo tekee tajunnanräjäyttävän paluun entisen FBI-agentti Macheten saappaisiin Robert Rodriguezin ohjaamassa, edeltäjäänsäkin roisimmassa jatko-osassa. Kuoleman porteilta palannut tappokone Machete on jälleen pelikentällä - tällä kertaa lain oikealla puolella. Yhdysvaltain Presidentin itsensä rekrytoima Machete on kasvokkain tehtävän kanssa, joka on mahdoton kenelle tahansa kuolevaiselle. Vastassa on mielipuolinen, vallankumouksellinen ja äärettömän itserakas miljardööri, joka on valtaisan asekauppabisneksensä ohessa päättänyt levittää sotaisaa kaaosta ja anarkiaa pitkin poikin planeettaamme.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Power Rangers on viiden tavallisen lukiolaisen tarina. He löytävät ikivanhan avaruusaluksen ja huomaavat yhtäkkiä saaneensa yliluonnolliset voimat. Viisikko äkkää, että muukalaiset aikovat tuhota heidän pienen kotikaupunkinsa Angel Groven ja siinä samassa koko maailman, joten heidän on ryhdyttävä maailmanpelastajiksi.

programme.title: Turpiin vaan ja tuplaten
programme.desc: Kaksoisolentojen välittämiseen erikoistunut yritys saa tilauksen kahdelta äärimmäisen vaikutusvaltaiselta liikemieheltä sijaistensa etsimiseksi. Hätiin löytyvät saksofonisti Greg ja surffaaja Eliot. Kaksi huoletonta heppua, joita ei missään nimessä pitäisi määrätä minkään tärkeän vartijaksi. Greg ja Eliot suostuvat muitta mutkitta kaksoisolennoiksi, ja nauttivat täysin rinnoin hetkittäisestä elämänmuutoksesta. Mutta todellinen kulttuurishokkiaalto odottaa kuitenkin kaikkia niitä, jotka joutuvat kohtaamaan Gregin ja Eliotin uusina itsenään, ja tuhon, jonka he tuovat tullessaan!

programme.title: Senkka nenästä pojat!
programme.desc: Järjestäytyneen rikollisuuden vedonlyöjät, korttihait ja huijarit piinaavat toimillaan Miamia, ja poliisin johto on päättänyt ottaa kovat keinot käyttöön ja puhdistaa kaupungin. Mutta koska poliisin omat resurssit eivät riitä toivottuun lopputulokseen, värvätään veljekset, Johnny ja Charlie Flippo, likaisen työn hommaan...Vaikka Johnny on laivaston upseeri ja Charlie vain rekkakuski, on heidän urbaanit selviytymiskykynsä ja kontaktit legendaariset. Veljekset sukeltavat alamaailman kuvioihin kuin kalat veteen, ja pistävät taidoillaan sekä nyrkeillään rikollisten päät sekaisin! Mutta Johnny ja Charlie eivät ole kuvioissa mukana hyvää hyvyyttään - täytyyhän omista eduista pitää myös kiinni.

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen. Yksin ja eksyksissä valtameren yllä heidän on lennettävä itse vioittunut kone maihin ennen kuin polttoaine loppuu.

programme.title: Instrument of War
programme.desc: Kun Yhdysvaltain ilmavoimien B-24 pommikoneen pilotti Clair Cline ammutaan alas ja vangitaan Saksassa, hänen osaltaan yksi sota loppuu ja toinen - toivon ylläpitäminen - alkaa. Natsien piikkilanka-aitojen saartama Cline ja muut sotavangit etsivät selviämisen lisäksi keinoja peitota vankeus. Perustuu tositapahtumiin.

programme.title: Legal Action
programme.desc: Lahjakas asianajaja Casey McKay matkustaa ex-vaimonsa kotikaupunkiin puolustamaan tämän veljeä, jota syytetään piirisyyttäjän murhasta. Siellä McKay saa selville salaliiton, joka johtaa hänet avoimeen konfliktiin kaupungin korruptoituneimman rakennuttajan Gatesin kanssa. Entinen merijalkaväen sotilas auttaa Caseyta, kun käy ilmi, että hän tarvitsee muutakin kuin juridista asiantuntemusta pysyäkseen hengissä ja voittaakseen jutun

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Survivor on sähäkkä vakoiluelokuva Kate Abbottista, joka saa siirron Yhdysvaltain suurlähetystöön Lontooseen. Hänen tehtävänään on varmistaa, ettei terroristeille myönnetä viisumeja Yhdysvaltoihin. Erikoislaatuinen tehtävä tekee Abbottista silmätikun ja maalitaulun. Hänet yritetään murhata ja lavastaa rikolliseksi. Abbottin täytyy yrittää pelastaa maineensa ja estää uudenvuodenaatoksi suunniteltu terroristi-isku New Yorkin Times Squarella.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banaani Joen elämä on yhtä auringonpaistetta. Lokoisaa iloista oloa, ilman stressiä eteläisellä paratiisisaarella, kunnes... Joen asuinkylä on jäämässä modernin business-kulttuurin jalkoihin. Pian paikkaa pyörittävät byrokraatit ja jengit, pykälineen ja paheineen. Korruptio ja sääntöviidakko alkavat rehottaa paratiisissa, ja huoleton vapauden aurinko on jäämässä pahasti pyrkyreiden ja rahastajien varjoon. Joe ei lainkaan pidä siitä mitä on tapahtumassa, eikä ole valmis luopumaan idyllisestä paratiisistaan ilman taistelua. On aika takoa nyrkein joidenkin päähän järkeä, ja näyttää mistä kuuluu ja kuka käskee!

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho on kansainvälinen agentti, joka on ollut mukana vaikka missä: takaa-ajoissa, räjähdyksissä, putoamisissa. Ne eivät kuitenkaan ole mitään verrattuna hänenseuraavaan tehtäväänsä: hänen pitää hoitaa tyttöystävänsä kolmea kakaraa! Jo aamiainen ja koulumaksujen hoitaminen ovat rankkoja tehtäviä, mutta kun yksi lapsista suututtaa venäläisen terroristin, viikonloppu saa aivan uudenlaisen käänteen.Jackie Chaniin ei väsy koskaan eikä Jackie Chan ole koskaan liian vanha näyttämään taistelulajiosaamistaan tai tekemään vaarallisia stuntteja, sillä jälleen kerran hänellä on vastassaan vihollisia: pieniä lapsukaisia!

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Luc Bessonin toimintaelokuvan pääosassa upea Zoe Saldana (Avatar) pukeutuu koston mustaan raivatessaan tieltään vanhempiensa tappajat.COLOMBIANA on toiminnantäyteinen tarina nuoresta tytöstä, joka joutuu raakuuksien ja koston maailmaan. CATALEYA RESTREPO (Zoe Saldana) todistaa 10-vuotiaana vanhempiensa brutaalin murhan, jonka takana on pahamaineinen kolumbialainen rikollispomo DON LUIS. Cataleya pakenee EMILIO-setänsä luo Chicagoon, jossa hänestä kasvaa tappavan kaunis kuoleman lähetti...

programme.title: Bulletproof Monk
programme.desc: Vuosikausien ajan nimetön munkki on puolustanut ja suojellut muinaista kääröä – Äärettömän Voiman Kääröä – joka sisältää avaimen mittaamattomaan voimaan. Nyt munkin täytyy löytää suojatti; seuraava suojelija salaisuudelle. Kar (Seann William Scott) on erittäin epätodennäköinen ehdokas, katujen kasvatti joka on kiinnostunut vain itsestään. Kun hän pelastaa munkin vankeudesta, näistä kahdesta tulee tiimi joka suojelee maailmaa käärön pahimmalta ja vallanhimoisimmalta tavoittelijalta. Yhdessä seksikkään, vaikeasti tavoitettavan naisen, Bad Girlin avulla, he etsivät ja kohtaavat vaarallisen vihollisensa lopputaistelussa joka on täynnä toimintaa.

programme.title: Tracker
programme.desc: Vuoteen 1903 sijoittuva ihmisjahtidraama Jäljittäjä alkaa kun Arjan (Ray Winstone), Etelä-Afrikan buurisodista selviytynyt sissi, saapuu Uuden-Seelannin siirtokuntaan ja hänelle luvataan palkkio Kereaman (Temuera Morrison), sotilaan tappamisesta syytetyn maori merimiehen, kiinniottamisesta. Tehtävä, jonka pitäisi olla helppo mestarijäljittäjä Arjanille muuttuu mukaansatempaavaksi ja vaaralliseksi kissa ja hiiri -leikiksi Kereaman, joka vannoo koko ajan viattomuuttaan, paetessa ja jäädessä kiinni yhä uudestaan. Yliotteen vaihtuessa vuoronperään mieheltä toiselle, Arjan ja Kereama alkavat tutustumaan toisiinsa – ja lopulta kunnioittamaan toisiaan.

programme.title: Murder Company
programme.desc: Murder Company perustuu tositapahtumiin toisen maailmansodan aikana ja seuraa amerikkalaissotilaiden erikoista ryhmää D-Dayn hyökkäyksen aikana. Komppanialla on mahdoton tehtävä: Ranskan vastarintaliikkeen jäsen viedään natsien tukikohtaan, jossa hän salamurhaa tärkeän kohteen.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Survivor on sähäkkä vakoiluelokuva Kate Abbottista, joka saa siirron Yhdysvaltain suurlähetystöön Lontooseen. programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: Nuori FBI-agentti soluttautuu porukkaan, jonka epäillään suunnitelleen sarjan röyhkeitä ryöstöjä. Ryhmään soluttautumisessa on haasteensa: sen kaikki jäsenet ovat nimittäin toinen toistaan kovakuntoisempia ja taitavampia extreme-urheilijoita, jotka ovat tavoittamattomissa yhtä lailla maalla, merellä kuin ilmassa...

programme.title: Superkyttä
programme.desc: Dave Speed on Miamin poliisivoimien rämäpää, jolta rikollisuuden kitkeminen hoituu luonnostaan. Erästä tehtävää hoitaessaan, Dave altistuu pahemman kerran ydinaseen säteilylle, eikä mikään ole enää kuin ennen. Hän saa yliluonnolliset supervoimat, ja pian Miamin rikoskäyrät ovat rajussa laskussa. Vastavetona päättävät kaupungin päärikolliset ratkaista ongelman nimeltä Dave Speed hinnalla ja keinolla millä hyvänsä... Superkytän voimat joutuvat kerta toisensa jälkeen todelliselle koetukselle, mutta ei hätää, niin kauan kuin hän ei näe mitään punaista. Kyseinen väri on Davelle kuin kryptoniitti Teräsmiehelle...

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: Power Rangers on viiden tavallisen lukiolaisen tarina. He löytävät ikivanhan avaruusaluksen ja huomaavat yhtäkkiä saaneensa yliluonnolliset voimat. Viisikko äkkää, että muukalaiset aikovat tuhota heidän pienen kotikaupunkinsa Angel Groven ja siinä samassa koko maailman, joten heidän on ryhdyttävä maailmanpelastajiksi.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Ahkera lukiolainen Vee Delmonico on kyllästynyt olemaan varjossa. Kun kaverit painostavat osallistumaan suosittuun nettipeliin, Nerveen, Vee päättää osallistua yhteen kisaan harmitonta hupia. Hänen parikseen osuu salaperäinen kaveri, jota hän ei tunne entuudestaan. Jännittävä peli muuttuu aina vaarallisemmaksi ja panokset vain kovenevat hurjassa finaalissa.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: "Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman, jolle vanhemmat rouvat jalokivineen ovat helppoja saaliita. Pian kuitenkin panokset pelissä muuttuvat kovemmiksi, kun Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun. Mafian ollessa valmis raivaamaan todistajat hengiltä tylyn armottomalla tyylillään, on Parkerin suojeltava Tonya ja varmistettava tämän pääsy elossa todistamaan. Kytän ja varkaan epätavallinen taistelupari saa aikaa valtaisaa tuhoa alamaailman keskuudessa..."

programme.title: The Spy Next Door

programme.title: Joyride
programme.desc: Hurmaava Jon on epäonnistunut elämässään ja päättää lähteä tavoittelemaan menetettyä rakkautta. Autoekspertti Luke pakenee menneisyyttään. Yhdessä hampurilaispaikassa työskentelevän vegaaniaktivisti Keiran kanssa he rikkovat normeja ja päätyvät ajamaan “lainatulla” keltaisella Mini Cooperilla Uuden-Seelannin poikki, poliisi ja media perässään.

programme.title: Delta Farce
programme.desc: Kolmea ystävystä luullaan sotilaiksi ja heidät laitetaan Irakin lentokoneeseen. Kun heidät on tiputettu lentokoneesta, löytävät he itsensä syrjäisestä kylästä, joka tarvitsee kipeästi apua. Pystyvätkö he olemaan sankareita oikeasti?

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: Danny Trejo tekee tajunnanräjäyttävän paluun entisen FBI-agentti Macheten saappaisiin Robert Rodriguezin ohjaamassa, edeltäjäänsäkin roisimmassa jatko-osassa. Kuoleman porteilta palannut tappokone Machete on jälleen pelikentällä - tällä kertaa lain oikealla puolella. Yhdysvaltain Presidentin itsensä rekrytoima Machete on kasvokkain tehtävän kanssa, joka on mahdoton kenelle tahansa kuolevaiselle. Vastassa on mielipuolinen, vallankumouksellinen ja äärettömän itserakas miljardööri, joka on valtaisan asekauppabisneksensä ohessa päättänyt levittää sotaisaa kaaosta ja anarkiaa pitkin poikin planeettaamme.

programme.title: Colombiana
programme.desc: Luc Bessonin toimintaelokuvan pääosassa upea Zoe Saldana (Avatar) pukeutuu koston mustaan raivatessaan tieltään vanhempiensa tappajat.COLOMBIANA on toiminnantäyteinen tarina nuoresta tytöstä, joka joutuu raakuuksien ja koston maailmaan. CATALEYA RESTREPO (Zoe Saldana) todistaa 10-vuotiaana vanhempiensa brutaalin murhan, jonka takana on pahamaineinen kolumbialainen rikollispomo DON LUIS. Cataleya pakenee EMILIO-setänsä luo Chicagoon, jossa hänestä kasvaa tappavan kaunis kuoleman lähetti...

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: Simon Westin (The Expendables 2) ohjaama ja Nicholas Cagen tähdittämä räjäyttävä toimintatrilleri. Entinen varas Will Montgomery vapautuu vankilasta kärsittyään tuomionsa 10 miljoonan dollarin pankkiryöstöstä. Ensi töikseen hän lähtee tapaamaan tytärtään Alisonia, jota ei ole nähnyt viimeiseen kahdeksaan vuoteen. Kaikki menee kuitenkin pieleen kun Willin vanha rikoskumppani kidnappaa Alisonin vaatien vaatien hänestä 10 miljoonan dollarin takuita, jotka epäilee Willillä olevan piilossa vanhan ryöstön jäljiltä. Koska rahoja ei ole, joutuu Will suunnittelemaan uuden pankkiryöstön saadakseen rahat ja pelastaakseen tyttärensä.

programme.title: Jimmy Jones
programme.desc: Hyväsydäminen pikkurikollinen Jimmy Jones Malmöstä yrittää tienata rutkasti rahaa. Hän toimii välikätenä huumekaupassa, jota käyvät hollantilainen huumesyndikaatti ja Tukholmassa oleskeleva serbialainen pokerinpelaaja Dragan. Matkalla Tukholmaan tapahtuu se, mitä ei saa tapahtua – Jimmy ajaa naisen päälle. Hän pakenee paikalta ennen poliisin tuloa. Kun Dragan saa kuulla, että Jimmy on etsintäkuulutettu, hän alkaa lykätä korvauksen maksamista siinä toivossa, että poliisi ehtii napata Jimmyn. Samaan aikaan Hollannin syndikaatti haluaa rahansa, tai muuten Jimmy kuolee. Jimmy Jones on saman tason jännäri kuin Rahalla Saa - leffat.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Varkaita ja veijareita
programme.desc: "Bud Spencer esittää kovanyrkkistä poliisia, ylikonstaapeli Parkeria, joka saa tehtäväkseen ottaa kiinni lipevän gigolon, Tony Roman, jolle vanhemmat rouvat jalokivineen ovat helppoja saaliita. Pian kuitenkin panokset pelissä muuttuvat kovemmiksi, kun Tony todistaa Mafian tappoiskun. Mafian ollessa valmis raivaamaan todistajat hengiltä tylyn armottomalla tyylillään, on Parkerin suojeltava Tonya ja varmistettava tämän pääsy elossa todistamaan. Kytän ja varkaan epätavallinen taistelupari saa aikaa valtaisaa tuhoa alamaailman keskuudessa..."

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Ahkera lukiolainen Vee Delmonico on kyllästynyt olemaan varjossa. Kun kaverit painostavat osallistumaan suosittuun nettipeliin, Nerveen, Vee päättää osallistua yhteen kisaan harmitonta hupia. Hänen parikseen osuu salaperäinen kaveri, jota hän ei tunne entuudestaan. Jännittävä peli muuttuu aina vaarallisemmaksi ja panokset vain kovenevat hurjassa finaalissa.

programme.title: TMNT

programme.title: Horizon Line
programme.desc: Ex-pariskunta tapaa vuosien jälkeen osallistuessaan hyvän ystävänsä häihin. Heidän lentäessään trooppiselle saarelle valtameren yli pienellä, yksimoottorisella lentokoneella, pilotti saa kohtalokkaan sydänkohtauksen. Yksin ja eksyksissä valtameren yllä heidän on lennettävä itse vioittunut kone maihin ennen kuin polttoaine loppuu.

Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

Along the way, she realizes why Plovdiv is called the ‘Eternal City’ of Bulgaria.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Paul John Elliott
programme.desc: Without really knowing why, Paul Elliott will change his life from cartoonist to massage therapist. Aspired by success, money, success, he will create several clinics and will eventually lose the human aspects and lose himself. A new turn, a new meeting and Paul will finally resume his dreams of painting. Follow Paul in his tumults and his happiness found.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Annabelle Higgins and Valérie Sirois
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Annabelle Higgins and Valérie Sirois
programme.desc: They are beautiful sisters, they are passionate about nature and they have a very strong common point: entrepreneurship. After years of evolution in consumer sectors, discover Annabelle and Valérie who knew how to listen to their passion to create a fitness and surf club (for Annabelle) and a zero waste grocery store (for Valérie).

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Véronick Desmarais
programme.desc: The everyday work is not always easy and it is sometimes difficult to get by. If there is one thing that Véronick has learned from her experience and those around her, it is because she is able to surpass that and to embark on her dreams and plans to become a massage therapist. You will believe in your abilities too.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Violaine Courtois
programme.desc: Everything started from the dream of her parents, she becomes a veterinarian. In her career that she launched backwards, Violaine will meet people who will take her to a different path of life. The chance will be at the rendezvous but it is especially the courage to resume studies and create his company that will build his project. Follow the encounters and travels of Violaine that brought her to fasciatherapy and nonviolent communication.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Leah
programme.desc: Working 12 hours a day in the tech industry, Leah was living a fast paced high-life that only looked good on paper. Frequently ill and constantly exhausted, she experienced a burn out and decided to tackle meditation. What came next was a radical change in lifestyle that resulted in a move to Bali, The Island of the Gods. Today she sees her career blossom as she enjoys sharing her meditation knowledge with the world.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The wine route
programme.desc: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established. Julie will take us to Burgundy, where the most expensive wines in the world are produced, and then back to Bordeaux, to immerse ourselves in the world of high-tech and biodynamic wines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - winter vegetables
programme.desc: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits. Finally, we will conclude as usual with a recipe from a chef, who will go out of his way to create a seasonal recipe for us.

programme.desc: In Florida, the Everglades swamp is being restored at great expense. 15 billion dollars are being invested over thirty years to save the water supply of the entire region. In California, on the crests of the Tehachapi hills, the world's largest wind farm is being discovered. In China, the fermentation of excrement produces gas, mainly methane, which, when burned, is transformed into energy called biogas. In California, the Taft oil field was discovered, one of the largest in the world: nearly 10,000 wells on over 52,000 hectares. Then Haiti fights to save itself from deforestation. In Utah, Salt Lake City is a good example of how we live today: there are 37 cities in the world with more...

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Andrew
programme.desc: For many years, Andrew was a successful American child-actor on the popular show My Wife and Kids, until he dropped everything and embarked on a journey to find life’s true meaning. He now lives in Bali where he coaches people from all over the world on how to radically transform their diets. His 360° transformative journey includes meditation, yoga and nutrition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The mushroom route
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Truffle flavors
programme.desc: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. Truffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 1 - Everything is living and everything is linked - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Everything is living and everything is linked - Part 1
programme.desc: Through the most magnificent images and astonishing human stories, Man is at the heart of the biodiversity that he must respect and preserve. We find ourselves in Kenya, where the biodiversity is particularly rich, in the Massaï Mara reserve. Then, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the worrying disappearance of hippos from Lake Edward has unexpected consequences for the survival of fishermen. Then, in the sanctuary of life, the Pantanal region in Brazil, where millions of animal and plant species are teeming, some of the world's great wetlands also in danger. In Tasmania, Yann Arthus-Bertrand fights against the napalm deforestation of one of the oldest and most beautiful forests...

programme.title: My Zen Trendy - Season 1 - Paddle Yoga

Along the way, she can’t resist biting a mustard plant, feeding and ‘french kissing’ Stanley, the celebrity giraffe. She later harvests some fresh organic vegetables in Saddle Rock Garden!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The Auxerre country
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The chestnut route
programme.desc: Julie takes to the road in her little red car to honour one of her favourite fruits: the chestnut. Julie will meet several producers in Ardèche, cook the traditional soup of the region with the sparkling Marithé. She will also make the recipe for homemade marrons glacés, before heading to Corsica to work with chestnut flour and the leaves of her tree. This journey will end as always with a clever chef's recipe, and this time it will be Claude Brioude who will do it! This chef likes to shake up the rules and will work the chestnut with fish, two seasonal products that we are not usually used to combining.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Daniel Hautot
programme.desc: He had a real professional rise, quickly moving from commercial to sales manager. But the awareness quickly catches up with him too: what is the purpose of all this? Is it a real pursuit of happiness? Daniel keeps his acquired skills and puts them to the benefit of his passion for yoga. Follow Daniel until the opening of his yoga & community space.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Guillaume Nivelle
programme.desc: To make a profession representative of his personality is the discovery made by Guillaume at twenty-six. After several years as a bartender and crossing a dark period, Guillaume discovers nature and falls in love with it. Accompany Guillaume in his passion, in the middle of a refitted nature.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Laura Belfadla
programme.desc: Laura will not tell you the whole truth because she does not want a system where you are told what to do. After several years as head of business development in law firm, Laura changes her life and creates the plant academy. Let yourself go for a healthier life.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 2 - Laurence Sala
programme.desc: It took a burnout and several miscarriages to Laurence to take a new path. It's finally a bad thing for a good. Throughout her ordeals, Laurence will know how to listen to her needs, her desires and her passions. With a surprise, follow Laurence in her life as a mother and naturopath.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The country of Fontainebleau
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The country of Fontainebleau
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Fish on the menu
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Fish on the menu
programme.desc: Julie takes us to the southern Brittany and more precisely the maritime district of Guilvinec to follow the fish route from the nets to your plate. Le Guilvinec may be the first French artisanal fishing port, but all the seashores of France have good seasonal products. Julie drives up to the south to discover several farmed fish in an aquaculture farm in the Mediterranean, while cooking sea bass in Noirmoutier, monkfish in the north and even cod in the huge market at Rungis. Julie challenged Chef Olivier Bellin, who lives in Plomodiern in Finistère, to cook a little-known fish: the wrasse.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Yesmin
programme.desc: Born in Mexico but always attracted to new cultures and countries, Yesmin worked many jobs until she finally found her calling. She decided to merge her passions for art and travel and became a “Vagabond Artist”. She is now able to travel the world while making a living by painting beautiful murals in her own distinct style.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Jessica
programme.desc: Jessica’s life as a teenager was marked by a family tragedy that she struggled to cope with for a long time. Her anxiety had reached an all-time high and she was experiencing regular panic attacks when finally, she discovered surfing. This newfound passion thoroughly changed her lifestyle, ultimately resulting in a move to Bali, Indonesia. Today, she runs mindful surf & yoga retreats while also working online as a wellness writer.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 3 - Lisa & Pete

Together, they figured they were far from being ready for retirement. Instead, they dove headfirst into running an organic farm where they now both thrive while taking pleasure in returning to a simpler life.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The Land of the Impressionists

programme.desc: It is in Giverny that Julie's journey begins, the place whose name resounds as the cradle of Impressionism has kept a moving authenticity. Its fame is strongly linked to the historical presence of Claude Monet and to all the fabulous witnesses left by him. Claude Monet also left his mark on the cooking in Giverny. His recipe books are there to testify to this. It’s with these notebooks that Julie will be inspired to fill hers, on the menu: Rabbit in compote, andouilles puff pastry with camembert, and apricot charlottes.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Game season

Julie will also meet two hunters from Gironde for a very original afternoon of hunting by the barrel before joining Joël in Aquitaine for another game bird recipe. We will then talk with Laurent about the job of dog trainer. This time it will be Frédéric Robert who will concoct a recipe for hare rubbed with cocoa and cooked in a clay sarcophagus.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Lille country
programme.desc: Head north to discover a French city that cannot be ignored: Lille. The city has an exceptional architectural heritage, a merchant town since the Middle Ages, a citadel under Louis XIV, an industrial town in the 19th century... it expanded over the centuries. Julie will meet those who contribute to the fame of the city and its region, through its culinary heritage with the menu of this journey: the recipe of the coq à la bière, that of the hochepot and for a sweet note, a crème brûlée with chicory.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The flavors of olive oil

Then we head for an exceptional estate, the Villa Beaulieu, to taste a Bagna Cauda like you have rarely seen before finishing with Jean-Luc Rabanel, a starred organic chef and defenders of grand cru olive oil...

programme.desc: One woman’s personal mission to reduce her household rubbish turned into a passion that gave birth to Southeast Asia’s first Zero-Waste Bulk Food shop. Claire is a driven and successful mother of three who turned away from her corporate job to channel her business-savvy into reducing our impact on the environment and contributing to the improvement of her local community.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Zaira (Argentina)
programme.desc: For a long time Zaira let herself be defined solely as a survivor of the traumatic sexual assault that marked her life. In her healing search, she left behind the busy city life and moved to seek solace in the mountains of Mendoza. It is among these magnificent peaks that Zaira found peace within herself and harmony with her surroundings. Now, eager to help others heal, she is the leader of a trekking initiative that doubles as a support group for other women who are victims of sexual aggression.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Ile (Argentina)
programme.desc: Ileana studied business and worked long hours indoors for a multinational logistics company. Her love for dance and desire for movement drove her to quit her corporate life and begin a new chapter as a fitness trainer. Quickly exhausting the traditional methods available at her local gyms, she began to create innovative and groundbreaking exercise methods of her own. Her goal: to empower women by making them feel strong and feminine at the same time.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The Country of Le Mans
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Country of Le Mans
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Seashells on the menu

We will then go on a tour of France's best oysters: towards Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier and finally Oléron to learn about the different breeding methods and to find out more about all the species in France. Julie will cook a fricassee of berniques, the little Chinese hats that cover the rocks of the coast, as well as pink clams that are little known to the public. We will continue our journey in Finistère to meet Sylvain, the only abalone breeder in the country, and then to Méru where there are still workshops magnifying...

Area, so he can come face-to-face with a Dark Signer, namely Kalin Kessler, who seems to know Yusei very well.

To make matters worse, he has joined the Dark Signers whose plan is to destroy the world. Now, in order to settle things straight, Yusei and Kalin engage in a Duel while using the great picture as a stage.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E55 A King and His Queen S1 E55
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S03 : E43 Jodha Akbar S3 E43
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.sub-title: S03 : E44 Jodha Akbar S3 E44
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: A King and His Queen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E51 A King and His Queen S1 E51
programme.desc: Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani is the story of the Royal Family of Ameerkot, which is headed by Rajmata and Rana Indravadhan Singh Deo (Siddhant Karnick). To cope with the loss of fortune faced, he marries Gayatri Seth (Drashti Dhami), the daughter of the state's biggest moneylender, Gopal Seth. This not only causes a scandal but sets off a chain of drama events within the family and the royal servants, impacting them to change forever. At the heart of this drama is the relationship between Ranaji, who is still in love with his dead wife, and a commoner, Gayatri who now discovers that becoming a Rani does not necessarily have a fairy tale ending. It is a journey of Gayatri from being a girl with no future since she is a manglik to becoming queen of Ranaji's heart and of the people of the land!

Kiinan matkaltaan Sydneyn lentoasemalle palaava perhe tekee virhearvion. Sydneyn ja Brisbanen postikeskuksissa on syynissä epäilyttäviä paketteja. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 5/20. Kielletyn kaman jäljet. Kaksi naista salakuljettaa kiellettyjä ruokia Sydneyn lentoasemalla, mutta asian taustalla oleva syy herättää virkailijoissa myötätuntoa. Thaimaasta Melbourneen saapunut nainen saattaa joutua katumaan matkalaukun lainaamista tuttavaltaan. Melbournen lentorahtiterminaalissa tutkitaan arveluttavaa kori- ja kynttiläpakkausta. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Australian rajalla

programme.title: Maailman salatuimmat hotellit
programme.desc: Kausi 1. Jakso 3/6. Lapin taikaa ja lentoaseman kuhinaa. Tällä kertaa tutustumme muun muassa igluihin Suomen Lapissa ja metsämajoitukseen Vancouverinsaarella. Luonnon lisäksi rauhaa voi hakea myös keskeltä John F. Kennedyn lentoaseman kuhinaa: Eero Saarisen suunnittelema terminaalirakennus on muunnettu 1960-luvun designia huokuvaksi hotelliksi. Englantilainen lifestyleohjelma.

programme.title: Maailman salatuimmat hotellit

Hyvinä esimerkkeinä tästä ovat viinitarhaan kätketty piilopaikka Uruguayssa, nosturihotelli Alankomaissa ja lomakohde vuoren huipulla Omanissa. Metsämaja Ruotsissa tarjoaa paluun perusasioiden äärelle. Englantilainen lifestyleohjelma.

programme.title: No title
programme.desc: (The World Is Not Enough/Britannia-USA 1999). Pierce Brosnanin kolmas James Bond -seikkailu käynnistyy MI6-tiedustelupalvelun päämajassa tapahtuvasta öljypohatta Robert Kingin murhasta. Syyllisen jäljittäminen kuljettaa salaisen agentin huippuvaarallisen, teknologiaan mieltyneen terroristin Renardin (Robert Carlyle) kannoille. Maailman öljyvarojen hallintaa tavoitteleva ihmispeto tavoittelee vadille myös Kingin hemaisevan tyttären Elektran (Sophie Marceau) kaunista päätä, jota Bond ilomielin suojelee. Hän saa taustatukea myös häikäisevän seksikkäältä tiedenaiselta Christmas Jonesilta (Denise Richards). 1990-luvun menestyneimmäksi Bond-seikkailuksi teatterikierroksellaan kohonneen elokuvan tunnuskappaleen esittää amerikkalaisyhtye Garbage. Pääosissa: Pierce Brosnan, Sophie Marceau, Robert Carlyle, Denise Richards, Robbie Coltrane, Judi Dench. Ohjaus: Michael Apted.

Tämä turvapaikka on kuitenkin ailahtelevainen, ja sen vuosittaisiin sademääriin ei voi luottaa. Tarjoaako Nxai Pan tänä vuonna elämää antavan välipysähdyksen Kalaharin suurimmalla muuttoreitillä, vai merkitseekö se kaikille kuolemaa tomupilvessä?

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: The Panda Way: Pandakoulun oppitunnit muuttuvat vaikeammiksi. Nuoret pennut painiskelevat vaikeasti syötävien bambunlehtien kanssa ja yrittävät kiivetä puihin sateessa. Leikkiaika opettaa niitä kanavoimaan synnynnäistä kömpelyyttään ja tekemään niistä sitkeämpiä karhuja. Pennut alkavat murtaa pandakoodia, ja jokainen niistä näyttää todellisen luonteensa ja osoittaa, mitä niiden tulevaisuus voisi pitää sisällään. Dirtbagin villin sydämen vaistot alkavat vaikuttaa, kun taas Can Yangin ulospäinsuuntautunut ja mukautuva luonne loistaa läpi. Uusi pandapari valmistautuu elämään ulkomailla, kun taas synnytysyksikössä pikkupennut kasvavat päivä päivältä söpömmiksi ja oppivat kävelemään. Vuoren huipulla ensilumi on haaste Tian Tianille ja sen kasvattamalle pennulle.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: Tiny Paws, Big World: Uusi luokka aloittaa pandakoulussa. Pikkupennut ovat viettäneet koko elämänsä äitiysyksikössä, mutta uskaltautuvat ensimmäistä kertaa ulos maailmaan, joka on täynnä uutta nähtävää, uusia ääniä ja uusia pandataitoja opittaviksi. Mini Ling Lang, kesän pennuista vanhin, saa selville, että sen emo on taitava kiipeilijä, ja se yrittää ottaa tämän kiinni. Su Jin Junior on itsepäinen, ja sen emo pitää sen ruodussa suoran opetustyylinsä avulla. Pikkukaksoset ovat liian nuoria aloittamaan kiipeämistä, mutta ne näyttävät parhaat temppunsa, kun lumi saapuu. Lumisade ei tarkoita, että koulu perutaan. Se tarkoittaa, että oppitunnit ovat vaikeampia. Samalla kun pienimmät pennut aloittavat koulunkäyntinsä, Tian Tianin pentu on ylhäällä vuorilla, ja sen oppitunnit ovat loppusuoralla. Se alkaa lähestyä elämää luonnossa.

programme.title: Unelmahäät
programme.desc: Lempääläläiset Melissa (o.s. Hyyhö), 29, ja Mika Järvensivu, 32, vihitään aiottua aikaisemmin osin terveydellisistä syistä. Sulhasen silmäsairaus saattaa johtaa lopulta hänen sokeutumiseensa, jonka vuoksi morsian on houkutellut tulevan puolisonsa osallistumaan häätapahtumaan, jossa pari vihitään Ideaparkin kauppakeskuksessa puoli vuotta ennen lukkoon lyötyä hääpäivää. Näin morsian haluaa varmistaa, että sulhanen näkee ja kokee suuren päivän ja laitetun nuorikkonsa vielä kaikilla aisteillaan. Pari avioituu elämäntilanteessa, jossa Mika on jo ehtinyt nähdä kahden lapsensa syntymän ja tutustua Melissan aiemmista suhteista syntyneisiin kahteen lapseen. Vaikeista ajoista huolimatta pari on näin saavuttanut jo isoja unelmiaan ja uskoo, että tästä kaikki vasta alkaa.

programme.title: Unser grüner Planet (1/5)
programme.desc: Die neue bildgewaltige Dokumentationsreihe Unser grüner Planet setzt die erfolgreiche Planet-Reihe der BBC fort und zeigt die Wunderwelt der Pflanzen, wie sie noch nie zu sehen war.

programme.title: Unser grüner Planet (2/5)
programme.desc: Zu den charakteristischsten Wüstenpflanzen gehören Kakteen. Eine der größten Arten ist der Saguaro, der im Südwesten Nordamerikas vorkommt. In ihrem Innern speichern sie Wasser. Um möglichst viel davon aufnehmen zu können, ist der Stamm mit flexiblen Rippen überzogen, die sich ausdehnen und zusammenziehen können. Eine weitere Kaktusart wächst auf einer abgelegenen felsigen Insel vor der Küste Mexikos. Die Kakteen haben dort einen Weg gefunden, die toxischen Anteile des Kots der dort nistenden Seevögel zu tolerieren und die ebenfalls enthaltenen Nährstoffe für ihr Wachstum zu nutzen.

programme.title: Unser grüner Planet (3/5)
programme.desc: Eine spannende Expedition ins Reich der Pflanzen: Welche Überlebensstrategien nutzen sie, um in verschiedenen Klimazonen zu gedeihen? Und welche Herausforderungen stellen die unterschiedlichen Jahreszeiten für Pflanzen dar?

programme.title: Unser grüner Planet (4/5)
programme.desc: Mit welchen Tricks überleben Pflanzen im Wasser? Denn Wasserpflanzen müssen mit starken Strömungen, Dunkelheit und Mangel an Nährstoffen zurechtkommen. Eine Welt voller Überraschungen!

programme.title: Unser grüner Planet (5/5)
programme.desc: Das Verhältnis von Menschen und Pflanzen ist ein komplexes. Pflanzen liefern Nahrung, Luft zum Atmen oder Kleidung. Aber dieses Verhältnis ändert sich und damit auch die Zukunft unseres grünen Planeten. Obwohl Pflanzen oft nur wenig Beachtung finden, sind sie die heimlichen Herrscher unseres grünen Planeten. Ihre Vielfalt an Formen und Farben scheint unerschöpflich und reicht von mikroskopisch kleinen Algen bis zum gigantischen Mammutbaum.

programme.title: Traumorte - Hokkaido
programme.desc: Hokkaidō ist Japans nördlichste Hauptinsel und ein Paradies für Naturfreunde. Dichter Schnee und eine von Treibeis bedeckte Küste verwandeln sie in in ein Winterwunderland.

programme.title: Die Muttergottes und ihre Erscheinungen
programme.desc: Die Marienerscheinungsorte Lourdes und Medjugorje ziehen jedes Jahr Millionen Pilger an. Sie sind fasziniert von den mysteriösen Phänomenen und den Orten tiefer Frömmigkeit. Die Amtskirche selbst scheint gespalten, was das Phänomen der Marienerscheinungen betrifft. Während die Erscheinungen von Lourdes offiziell anerkannt sind, nimmt der Vatikan zur Echtheit jener in Medjugorje nicht Stellung. Die Marienverehrung an diesem Ort hat er aber neuerdings anerkannt. Nach welchen Kriterien werden solche Erscheinungen beurteilt? In welchem Zusammenhang stehen die Marienwunder mit politischen, wirtschaftlichen und ideologischen Bedingungen? Und was fasziniert gläubige Menschen immer wieder sich an solche Orte zu begeben?
